title: Monotone Classification with Relative Approximations
abstract: arXiv:2506.10775v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In monotone classification, the input is a multi-set $P$ of points in $\mathbb{R}^d$, each associated with a hidden label from $\{-1, 1\}$. The goal is to identify a monotone function $h$, which acts as a classifier, mapping from $\mathbb{R}^d$ to $\{-1, 1\}$ with a small {\em error}, measured as the number of points $p \in P$ whose labels differ from the function values $h(p)$. The cost of an algorithm is defined as the number of points having their labels revealed. This article presents the first study on the lowest cost required to find a monotone classifier whose error is at most $(1 + \epsilon) \cdot k^*$ where $\epsilon \ge 0$ and $k^*$ is the minimum error achieved by an optimal monotone classifier -- in other words, the error is allowed to exceed the optimal by at most a relative factor. translated_title: 单调分类中的相对近似
translated_abstract: 在单调分类中，输入是$\mathbb{R}^d$中点的多重集$P$，每个点关联一个隐藏标签，取自$\{-1, 1\}$。目标是找到一个单调函数$h$，作为分类器，从$\mathbb{R}^d$映射到$\{-1, 1\}$，其误差较小，误差定义为标签与函数值$h(p)$不同的点$p \in P$的数量。算法的成本定义为被揭示标签的点的数量。本文首次研究了找到误差至多为$(1 + \epsilon) \cdot k^*$的单调分类器所需的最低成本，其中$\epsilon \ge 0$，$k^*$是最优单调分类器实现的最小误差——换句话说，允许误差超过最优值的相对因子。对于$\epsilon$的全范围，提出了近乎匹配的上界和下界。所有先前关于该问题的研究只能实现...
tldr: 本文首次研究了单调分类中允许相对近似误差（即误差不超过最优值的$(1+\epsilon)$倍）时的最小查询成本，并给出了近乎匹配的上下界，填补了该领域理论空白。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first study on the minimum query cost for monotone classification with relative approximation error (i.e., error within a factor of $(1+\epsilon)$ of the optimum), achieving nearly matching upper and lower bounds for all $\epsilon$, filling a theoretical gap in prior work.
